// A wiper that names its collections inline and does NOT claim a project.
process.env.NODE_ENV = 'local';

const { db } = require('../../src/utils/firebase');
const { clearCollection, clearCollectionGroup } = require('../helpers/firebase-emulator');

beforeEach(async () => {
  await clearCollection(db, 'users');
  await clearCollectionGroup(db, 'backpack');
});
